scope: RFC9000 section 2 top-level pilot after user clarified incoming staged IDs should become canonical when obligations overlap.

downstream_surfaces_updated: VER verifies and prose evidence references

mappings.old_statement: Streams in QUIC MUST provide applications with an ordered byte-stream abstraction.
mappings.staged_statement: QUIC streams MUST provide an ordered byte-stream abstraction to an application.
mappings.action: Renamed canonical requirement ID to staged ID, adopted staged statement and coverage, moved requirement-home file/class and x_test_refs.

mappings.old_statement: Streams in QUIC MAY be created by sending data.
mappings.staged_statement: QUIC MUST allow streams to be created by sending data.
mappings.action: Renamed canonical requirement ID to staged ID, adopted staged stronger capability statement and coverage, moved requirement-home file/class and x_test_refs.

mappings.staged_statement: A single STREAM frame MUST be able to open, carry data for, and close a stream.
mappings.action: Added as incoming canonical requirement with upstream refs only; no downstream proof assigned in this slice.

mappings.old_statement: Streams in QUIC MAY concurrently send data interleaved with other streams.
mappings.staged_statement: QUIC MUST allow streams to send data concurrently interleaved with other streams.
mappings.action: Renamed canonical requirement ID to staged ID, adopted staged stronger capability statement and coverage, retargeted dependent proof refs.

mappings.old_statement: Streams in QUIC MAY be created by either endpoint.
mappings.staged_statement: QUIC MUST allow either endpoint to create streams.
mappings.action: Renamed canonical requirement ID to staged ID, adopted staged stronger capability statement and coverage, moved requirement-home file/class and API xref.

mappings.old_statement: Streams in QUIC MAY be canceled.
mappings.staged_statement: QUIC MUST allow streams to be canceled.
mappings.action: Renamed canonical requirement ID to staged ID, adopted staged stronger capability statement and coverage, moved requirement-home file/class and related frame proof refs.

mappings.old_statement: QUIC MUST NOT provide ordering between bytes on different streams.
mappings.staged_statement: QUIC MUST NOT provide any means of ensuring ordering between bytes on different streams.
mappings.action: Renamed canonical requirement ID to staged ID, adopted staged statement and coverage, moved requirement-home file/class and x_test_refs.

mappings.old_statement: QUIC MAY allow an arbitrary amount of data to be sent on any stream, subject to flow control constraints and stream limits.
mappings.staged_statement: QUIC MUST allow an arbitrary amount of data to be sent on any stream, subject to flow control constraints and stream limits.
mappings.action: Renamed canonical requirement ID to staged ID, adopted staged stronger capability statement and coverage, moved requirement-home file/class and related flow-control proof refs.

mappings.old_statement: QUIC MAY allow an arbitrary number of streams to operate concurrently.
mappings.staged_statement: QUIC MUST allow an arbitrary number of streams to operate concurrently, subject to flow control constraints and stream limits.
mappings.action: Renamed canonical requirement ID to staged ID, adopted staged stronger capability statement and coverage, moved requirement-home file/class and related max-stream proof refs.

mappings.staged_statement: A limited on-path attacker MUST NOT cause an idle connection to close if the client is first to resume activity.
mappings.action: Added as incoming canonical requirement with upstream refs only; no downstream proof assigned in this slice.
